forTheMorLead.what: When a role filling is final, so a payout made on it can be shown wrong
forTheMorLead.words: reads fillings from the acts held, and has no rule on when a filling is final, so any later act can unmake one, and a payout made on it can be shown wrong after the fact. Proposed: a filling counts as earned from the leg report that pays it, and no later act unmakes it. Where this falls on a particular cMIP, its maintainer has our report; the cMIP's own findings stay with it until fixed, or 432 blocks.
